status: Engineering assembly substitution; physical measurements pending

regulator.pin_orientation: Identify the pin-1 dot on the broad face. With that face towards you, dot at lower left and leads down, pins 1, 2, 3 run left to right. PCB top view and underside view must not be confused.
regulator.efficiency_reference_condition: Datasheet full-load value at minimum input; not a measured hub efficiency or a constant at all loads.
protection: continuous short-circuit protection with automatic recovery
unprovided_protection: No protection against externally driven VOUT assumed

input_capacitor.reason: RECOM requires a 27 uF electrolytic at VIN-GND for hard plugging or excessive input slew; the 5 V assembly includes it rather than treating the >18 V emphasis as an exemption.

input_connection.source: Active isolated 5 V PoE splitter through inline fuse and carrier J1
input_connection.headroom_rule: Verify >=4.5 V at regulator pins 1-2 once input has entered regulated operation, including turn-on load transients and simultaneous load. Account for splitter tolerance, fuse, wire and contact drop. Verify clean startup without UVLO cycling during the initial ramp from zero. UVLO below 4.5 V does not extend the specified operating range. Never connect raw PoE or battery voltage.

rail_loads.published_current_kind: Manufacturer specifies 3.3 V; no worst-case module current published in referenced specification
TI chip current varies with RF power, frequency and temperature; this is a module reserve, not a certified maximum. A PA-equipped replacement requires a new budget.
Manufacturer operating current is less than 3 mA
Bosch Table 2 bare-sensor heater-start peak maximum under its stated conditions; not the breakout's guaranteed total

rail_loads.part: Carrier and module pull-ups, indicators and allowance

excluded_loads: U1 host: +5V_HOST through D1 and its own regulator
U2 XIAO ESP32C6: +5V_C6 through D2 and its own regulator
U3 XIAO MG24: +5V_ZB through D3 and its own regulator
budget.interpretation: Sizing reserve for the present peripheral rail only; not an idle-current estimate, measured peak, whole-hub power budget or PoE input-power prediction.

perfboard.grid: 8 columns A-H left to right, 8 rows 1-8 top to bottom, component-side view
perfboard.build_rule: Use insulated point-to-point links on the solder side; crossings are insulated, never solder-bridged. Gently form the capacitor's 2.0 mm leads to the 2.54 mm pad spacing without bending at the seal. Seat and restrain both bodies; do not use the SIP leads as structural supports. Route the J2 cable through strain relief. Verify all three nets by continuity before powering. Remove all unused row-8 pads and any copper in the rear strap band Y20.5-23 mm. Route the harness away from this band.

acceptance.output_limit_note: Project +/-5% acceptance target measured at the farthest module, including ripple/transients; not a tighter RECOM manufacturer guarantee.

measurement_plan.instructions: Copy the blank worksheet for each physical assembly. Record instrument, board revision, actual regulator marking, load, temperature and waveform filenames. Set up insulated probes with power off; use each named local ground. Controller 3V3 pads are measurement points only: do not wire them together. Never connect powered USB during these tests. A DMM average, software build or blank worksheet does not pass transient or boot-strap checks.
measurement_plan.load_conditions: Check no-load startup first, then the assembled hub from cold start through thermal equilibrium with Ethernet traffic, three BLE connections, Thread and Zigbee radio activity, Z-Wave and CC1101 transmissions, LD2450 streaming and the BME680 heater. Scope startup, simultaneous-load transients, reset and power removal. Rail acceptance bands apply after the supply has entered regulation; initial zero-voltage ramp is not itself a failure. During the ramp and shutdown, verify clean reset and no damaging signal-pin injection between differently powered rails.
measurement_plan.host_input_rule: The Espressif DevKitC V4 schematic specifies an AMS1117-3.3 fed by EXT_5V. At U1.J2.19, after D1, require VIN(t)-VOUT(t) to exceed the fitted regulator manufacturer's guaranteed dropout for the relevant peak current and temperature, with allowance for measurement uncertainty and ripple. Record the fitted part and applicable datasheet bound; do not substitute the RECOM 4.5 V minimum or a typical dropout value. If that bound cannot be established, mark headroom unqualified even when a sample boots. Also pass the separate U1 local-3V3 measurement. Do not raise the shared splitter voltage to cure dropout: other modules remain on the specified 5 V supply.

rows.conditions: Initial detached test, then simultaneous load and thermal equilibrium
rows.acceptance: At least 4.5 V once regulated, including load transients; no repeated UVLO startup cycling. Confirm correct polarity before connecting J2.

rows.conditions: Detached loads 0/400/750 mA and 100-750 mA steps, then assembled simultaneous load
rows.acceptance: Project 3.3 V +/-5% band including ripple and load transients after regulation; inspect startup/shutdown separately.

rows.positive_probe: ZAC93 physical pin 1, at the module
rows.ground_probe: ZAC93 physical pin 6, at the module
rows.conditions: Simultaneous load including Z-Wave transmission, cold start and thermal equilibrium
rows.acceptance: Project 3.3 V +/-5% band at the cable destination, including ripple and load transients. Check both ZAC93 ground leads by unpowered continuity first.

rows.conditions: Measure simultaneously with U1 local 3V3 during peak load and at thermal equilibrium
rows.acceptance: Apply host_input_rule: VIN-VOUT must exceed the fitted regulator's guaranteed dropout at the tested current and temperature, plus ripple/measurement margin. Record the bound and measured minimum headroom in notes; no fixed 4.5 V pass threshold applies here.

rows.conditions: Cold start, three BLE connections and all hub protocols active, through thermal equilibrium
rows.acceptance: Project 3.3 V +/-5% band after regulation, including ripple and transients; no brownout/restart. The WROVER-IE operating range is 3.0-3.6 V; that wider range is not a substitute for this design target or the separate dropout check.

rows.conditions: Cold start, Thread radio traffic, host-controlled reset and thermal equilibrium
rows.acceptance: Project 3.3 V +/-5% band after regulation, including ripple and transients. The U2 header 5 V path has its own onboard diode and regulator; a good peripheral rail does not qualify this local rail.

rows.conditions: Cold start, Zigbee transmissions and thermal equilibrium
rows.acceptance: Project 3.3 V +/-5% band after regulation, including ripple and transients. Check at the local regulator output; do not infer it from J2 or connect it to J2.3.

rows.conditions: Cold power-up and host EN reset, with WIZ850io and actual CC1101 connected
rows.acceptance: Remain at or below 0.25 times measured U1 local VDD during the datasheet strap-sampling interval around EN release. Use a scope; a later SPI waveform or DMM average cannot establish the boot level. GPIO12 LOW selects 3.3 V VDD_SDIO.

rows.conditions: Host EN reset with GPIO0 held LOW by J9 service short; all modules attached, no powered USB
rows.acceptance: Remain at or below 0.25 times measured U1 local VDD during the datasheet strap-sampling interval. This verifies the GPIO2 condition for UART download; it does not qualify USB power isolation or prove a complete flash operation. Remove J9 short afterwards.

checks: Power the offboard assembly first from a correctly polarized, current-limited 5 V supply, with J2 disconnected; verify VIN, VOUT and capacitor polarity.
Verify no short between VIN, GND and VOUT, and both J2 ground wires reach regulator pin 2.

Measure input/output startup and shutdown, hard plug at the external splitter, and 100-750 mA load steps with a scope; observe input-slew limit and rail targets. Do not hot-plug internal J2 or radio harnesses.
Exercise Ethernet, Z-Wave TX, CC1101 TX and BME680 heater concurrently; measure current and far-end voltage. The 400 mA figure remains an engineering reserve until measured.
Run the assembled enclosed hub to thermal equilibrium at its maximum intended ambient; respect the lowest component limit and RECOM derating, not its marketing temperature headline.

Flash boards while loose before soldering into the carrier. After assembly use supported OTA; USB service requires a separately verified power-isolation arrangement, or desoldering the board for loose-board service. Do not power an assembled radio alone from USB: D1-D3 do not block signal-pin backpower into the unpowered peripheral rail and VOUT.
Do not connect any board's local 3.3 V output to +3V3. No output-blocking diode is fitted, because its drop would alter the rail design.
acceptance.emc_status: System emissions not tested. The datasheet's EN55032 Class B result requires its external filter; the 27 uF input capacitor alone does not establish Class B compliance.
